name: mcp.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: AI Connect
description: Connect your own AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor and others) to your AVADO. It can check how your box is doing, read app logs and explain problems in plain words. ChatGPT and Claude connect with one Connect button and your OK on the AVADO. Changes (restarting, installing or updating apps) stay off until you switch them on, and every change is listed on the page in plain words. The page is locked with a PIN you choose. It can never see your validator keys, wallets, recovery phrases or passwords, never change withdrawal or fee settings, and never remove apps or data.
shortDescription: Let your own AI assistant check and look after your AVADO
author: AVADO
